title: SCE Experiment 1.4 - Preventive Probe: IAM Permission Boundary Blocks IMDS Modification
description: Validates that IAM permission boundaries and restrictive policies successfully prevent unauthorized modification of EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) configuration. This experiment creates an EC2 instance with IMDSv2 enforced and a hop limit of 1, then attempts to weaken these settings using credentials subject to a permission boundary that explicitly denies ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions. The hypothesis is verified by confirming the modification attempt is blocked and the secure IMDS configuration remains unchanged.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: IMDS Configuration Remains Secure After Attack Attempt
